name: file_views
signature: fn file_views(&self, log_store: &dyn LogStore, predicate: Option<PredicateRef>) -> BoxStream<'_, DeltaResult<LogicalFileView>>
docs:
Stream the active files in the snapshot

This function returns a stream of [`LogicalFileView`] objects,
which represent the active files in the snapshot.

## Parameters

* `log_store` - A reference to a [`LogStore`] implementation.
* `predicate` - An optional predicate to filter the files.

## Returns

A stream of [`LogicalFileView`] objects, newest first.

name: transaction_version
signature: async fn transaction_version(&self, log_store: &dyn LogStore, app_id: impl ToString) -> DeltaResult<Option<i64>>
docs:
Return the latest committed transaction version for the given application id, if any.

This is used to implement idempotent writes: an application records its own monotonic
version via a transaction action, and readers can recover the last value seen.
